name: TruLens documented agent evaluations
description: Publisher-documented agent evaluation capabilities of the TruLens 2.15.0 metapackage, for arriving traces and offline datasets. This version pins the published capability description; its ranged implementation/provider dependencies do not constitute a reproduced evaluator environment. This is a source-only component capability profile, not a dataset selection, measured result, model or data permission, contract-validity result or deployment gate.
